description: Original Salareen Khmer music-video translation lesson. Sections are instructional lyrics with gist paraphrases for RAG scoring; no commercial copyrighted recording is embedded.

records.title_target: ដំណើរផ្សងព្រេងភាសាខ្មែររបស់យើង
records.source_note: Optional cultural listening reference is public-domain. Instructional section lyrics are original Salareen content.

sections.target: ជំរាបសួរ សុខសប្បាយទេ? រីករាយណាស់ជួបអ្នក
sections.roman: Chum reap suor, sok sabbai te? Rikreay nas chuob anak
sections.en: Hello, how are you? It is very nice to meet you.
sections.explain_en: A warm greeting: say hello, ask how someone is, and say you are happy to meet them.
sections.tts_text: ជំរាបសួរ។ សុខសប្បាយទេ? រីករាយណាស់ជួបអ្នក។
paraphrases_en: Greeting someone and saying nice to meet you
Hello and asking if they are well

sections.target: សូមទោស បន្ទប់ទឹកនៅឯណា? វានៅទីនោះ ខាងស្តាំ
sections.roman: Som tos, bantob tuek nov aena? Vea nov ti nuh, khang sdam
sections.en: Excuse me, where is the bathroom? It is over there, on the right.
sections.explain_en: Politely ask where the bathroom is, then point it out on the right.
sections.tts_text: សូមទោស។ បន្ទប់ទឹកនៅឯណា? វានៅទីនោះ។ ខាងស្តាំ។
paraphrases_en: Asking where the toilet is and saying it is on the right
Excuse me, bathroom directions to the right

sections.target: ម្ហូបនេះជាអ្វី? ឆ្ងាញ់ណាស់ សុំទឹកមួយ
sections.roman: Mhoob nih chea avei? Chhnganh nas, som teuk muoy
sections.en: What is this dish? It is very delicious. Water, please.
sections.explain_en: Ask about a dish, praise how tasty it is, then ask for water.
sections.tts_text: ម្ហូបនេះជាអ្វី? ឆ្ងាញ់ណាស់។ សុំទឹកមួយ។
paraphrases_en: Asking what the food is and saying it tastes great, then requesting water
Complimenting a delicious meal and ordering water
What food is this? It is tasty. May I have water?

sections.target: មួយនេះតម្លៃប៉ុន្មាន? ថ្លៃពេក ថោកជាងនេះបានទេ?
sections.roman: Muoy nih tamlay ponman? Thlai pek. Thok cheang nih ban te?
sections.en: How much is this? Too expensive. Can it be cheaper?
sections.explain_en: Ask the price, say it costs too much, and politely bargain for a lower price.
sections.tts_text: មួយនេះតម្លៃប៉ុន្មាន? ថ្លៃពេក។ ថោកជាងនេះបានទេ?
paraphrases_en: Asking the price and bargaining because it is too expensive
How much does this cost? Too pricey — can you lower it?
Shopping talk about price and getting a discount

sections.target: ខ្ញុំមិនយល់ទេ សូមនិយាយម្តងទៀត យឺតៗ
sections.roman: Khnyom min yol te. Som niyeay mdong tiet, yeut yeut
sections.en: I do not understand. Please say it again, slowly.
sections.explain_en: Admit you did not understand, then ask for a slow repetition.
sections.tts_text: ខ្ញុំមិនយល់ទេ។ សូមនិយាយម្តងទៀត។ យឺតៗ។
paraphrases_en: Saying you do not understand and asking them to repeat slowly
Please say that again more slowly
I did not get it — can you repeat slowly?

sections.target: អរគុណច្រើន ជំរាបលា ជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ
sections.roman: Aw kohn chraen. Chum reap lear. Chuob knea pel kraoy
sections.en: Thank you very much. Goodbye. See you next time.
sections.explain_en: Close warmly with thanks, goodbye, and a promise to meet again.
sections.tts_text: អរគុណច្រើន។ ជំរាបលា។ ជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ។
paraphrases_en: Saying thank you, goodbye, and see you later
Grateful farewell and see you next time
Thanks a lot — bye, until we meet again
